methodology: 60 real merchant snapshots. Agent reviewed visible title, sales state, condition and shipping text. All 30 Mercari prices independently checked in native browser; Rakuten prices cross-checked with ranking and product price DOM. No human-review claim. Initial automated QA price reads rejected where shipping/group prices could contaminate them. In-sample regression cohort, not holdout accuracy.
